mapper.sql: id, project_id, document_id, parse_run_id, block_id, section_path, customer_clause_no, title, level, parent_id, original_text, requirement_text, metrics_json, conditions_text, obligation, extraction_status, review_reasons, sort_order, version, created_at
mapper.select: select from requirement where project_id = #{projectId} order by sort_order asc
select from requirement where document_id = #{documentId} order by sort_order asc
mapper.insert: insert into requirement (id, project_id, document_id, parse_run_id, block_id, section_path, customer_clause_no, title, level, parent_id, original_text, requirement_text, metrics_json, conditions_text, obligation, extraction_status, review_reasons, sort_order, version, created_at) values (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{documentId}, #{parseRunId}, #{blockId}, #{sectionPath}, #{customerClauseNo}, #{title}, #{level}, #{parentId}, #{originalText}, #{requirementText}, #{metricsJson}, #{conditionsText}, #{obligation}, #{extractionStatus}, #{reviewReasons}, #{sortOrder}, coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update requirement set customer_clause_no = #{customerClauseNo}, title = #{title}, level = #{level}, requirement_text = #{requirementText}, review_reasons = #{reviewReasons}, extraction_status = #{extractionStatus}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
